name: How does the Denver area climate affect garage trim material choices?

mainEntity.name: How does the Denver area climate affect garage trim material choices?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the Denver metro area, the intense sun exposure, low humidity, and rapid freeze-thaw cycles place severe stress on exterior garage trim. Wood trim tends to dry out, check, and crack quickly on south- and west-facing garages, while winter snow accumulation along driveway edges causes base trim rot. High-grade composite trim or properly back-primed cedar paired with flexible, UV-resistant exterior caulking handles local temperature swings best. Choosing materials engineered for high sun exposure and moisture resistance prevents frequent repainting and premature board failure.
acceptedAnswer.description: Denver's intense sunlight and freeze-thaw cycles cause wood trim to crack and rot quickly. Rot-resistant PVC or treated wood with UV-stable sealant holds up best over time.
